projects.title: Earth Kings
projects.tagline: A tactical RPG in a hostile world where characters die for good, made by two brothers in Godot.

projects.title: Skill Engine
projects.tagline: A real-life RPG where you are the character: a graph of real skills, missions that train them, and an AI examiner that checks you can actually do them.

projects.title: Brick

projects.title: Chronicle
projects.tagline: A persistent medieval world of mortal AI lives, where knowledge outlives the knower and every death leaves an honest record.

projects.title: History Manga
projects.tagline: Real history and Irish legend as five-minute scroll-down comics, built from primary sources with a page on what's real in every chapter.

projects.title: Plate
projects.tagline: A household food log that finds which ingredients keep turning up when something disagrees with you, and admits when it doesn't know.
